scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Koko, your brave and trusty guide. Today, we're going to explore the wonderful world of confidence. Confidence is like having a bright, shiny light inside you that helps you do amazing things. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with me? I can't wait to share some fun stories and activities that will help you feel strong and courageous. Let's get started and discover the power of believing in yourself!

Confidence means feeling sure of yourself and your abilities. It's like when you try something new, like tying your shoes or riding a bike, and you believe you can do it. Imagine you have a superhero cape that gives you the courage to face any challenge. Sometimes, we all feel a little scared or unsure, and that's okay. But with practice and a little bravery, we can build our confidence and become stronger. Remember, every small step you take helps your confidence grow!

Let's learn how to boost our confidence with a simple exercise. First, stand up tall like a mighty tree. Now, take a deep breath in through your nose, and slowly blow it out through your mouth. Let's do that together three times. Each breath helps you feel calm and strong. Imagine you're filling up with courage, just like a superhero charging up their powers. Great job! This is something you can do anytime you need a little extra boost of confidence.

Now that we've practiced our breathing, let's talk about trying new things. Have you ever tried something new, like drawing a picture or building with blocks? It's normal to feel a little nervous when you start. But remember, every time you try, you're building your confidence. Just like a superhero learns new skills, you can too! So, the next time you try something new, give yourself a cheer and say, 'I can do this!' You're doing amazing!

Let’s think about a time when you felt really proud of yourself. Maybe it was when you helped a friend or finished a puzzle. Those proud moments are like little trophies for your confidence. They remind you that you can do great things. Whenever you feel unsure, remember those trophies and how they made you feel. They’re like a collection of special memories that show how strong and capable you are. Keep collecting those trophies by trying your best every day!

Now, let's play a fun game called 'Confidence Counting.' We'll count to five, and with each number, think of something you're good at or something you love to do. Ready? One, maybe it's drawing. Two, perhaps it's singing. Three, how about running fast? Four, maybe you like to tell stories. Five, could it be building with blocks? See, you already have so many amazing skills! Every time you count, remind yourself of all the things you can do.

You're doing such a fantastic job! Let's talk about how being kind to yourself helps build confidence. Sometimes we make mistakes, and that’s okay. Even superheroes make mistakes! The important thing is to say kind words to yourself, like 'I tried my best' or 'I'll keep practicing.' These words help you feel better and more confident. Remember, you’re your own best friend, and being kind to yourself makes you even stronger!

Let’s imagine you’re a superhero on a mission. Your mission is to try something new today. It could be helping to set the table or learning a new song. As you complete your mission, you'll gain more confidence points, just like a superhero earns badges. Every new thing you try adds to your superhero skills. So, what's your mission going to be today? Remember, you have the power to succeed, just like a true hero!

Can you think of a time when you felt really brave? Maybe it was when you tried something for the first time. How did that make you feel? It’s exciting to hear about your brave moments because they show how strong you are. Every time you feel brave, it's like adding a special star to your confidence cape. Would you like to share your story with me? I’d love to hear it!

Now, let's talk about how practice can help us feel more confident. Have you ever practiced something, like playing an instrument or doing a puzzle? The more you practice, the better you get, and the more confident you feel. It's just like superheroes who train to get stronger. Every time you practice, you’re building your skills and your confidence. So, keep practicing, and soon you'll feel like a superhero ready to take on anything!

Let's do another exercise to build confidence. Imagine you're putting on a superhero cape. Stand tall, close your eyes, and picture your cape flowing behind you. Now, think of a superhero name for yourself. Maybe it's 'Brave Alex' or 'Mighty Mia.' With your superhero name and cape, you can do anything! Whenever you need a boost, remember your superhero name and how strong you feel right now. You’re ready to take on the world!

You're becoming more and more confident with each step. Always remember that your friends and family are there to support you. Just like how superheroes have sidekicks, you have people who believe in you and cheer you on. When you feel unsure, you can always ask for help, and that's okay. Working together with others makes you even stronger. You're never alone on your journey to confidence!

Let’s go over what we've learned about confidence today. We talked about how confidence is like a light inside you that helps you do amazing things. We practiced breathing, played games, and imagined ourselves as superheroes. We also learned that being kind to ourselves and practicing helps our confidence grow. Remember, confidence is something you build every day, and you’re already doing a great job. Keep shining your light bright!

Thank you for joining me on this journey of confidence, little hero! Remember, you have the courage and strength to do anything you set your mind to. Keep practicing, be kind to yourself, and never stop believing in your abilities. I'm so proud of you and all the progress you've made today. Until next time, keep being the amazing, confident superhero you are. Goodbye, and see you soon!
